title: AI Knowledge Assistant Platform
tagline: Enterprise AI assistant using a reusable RAG framework
summary: An enterprise AI assistant that answers questions over domain-specific company knowledge, built on a reusable RAG framework with role-based access to what each user may retrieve.
overview: An enterprise-grade AI knowledge assistant that lets employees query internal, domain-specific knowledge and get context-aware answers generated by LLMs.

At its core is a reusable Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework, so new knowledge bases can be plugged in without rebuilding the pipeline. Access control is enforced at retrieval time, so users only ever see answers grounded in knowledge they are authorized to read.

points: Built a reusable Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework to query domain-specific enterprise knowledge and generate context-aware responses.
Implemented dynamic knowledge-base selection so users can scope a conversation to the right source.
Implemented Role-Based Access Control so users can access and retrieve only authorized knowledge.
Designed conversation history and context management for multi-turn interactions, continuity and auditability.
Added user feedback and analytics to measure and improve response quality.
Mentored a junior developer and ran code reviews.
Contributed to architecture decisions and coordinated technical delivery across the module.

achievements: Leads the module end-to-end, from architecture to delivery.
RAG framework designed for reuse across knowledge domains.
Permission-aware retrieval: answers never leak unauthorized content.
